text: 35–40 min. Demonstrate section 9 using validation results. The saved threshold is 0.13, selected using hypothetical costs. Distinguish score, threshold and label. Forest scores are not automatically calibrated risks. Precision = TP/(TP+FP), recall = TP/(TP+FN). Test F1 is 0.465 and average precision is 0.688. AP summarizes ranking across thresholds. Keep test results frozen. Sources: src/reference.ipynb sections 7, 9–10; artifacts/machine_failure_metadata.json.

Consumer: python src/consumer.py --bootstrap-servers 127.0.0.1:9092 --metrics-every 20. Producer: python src/producer.py --bootstrap-servers 127.0.0.1:9092 --rate 5. Follow local/STREAMING.md for one-time setup. Its old absolute working-directory and environment paths need adaptation to this checkout. Producer replays the matching test split, not arbitrary synthetic sensor values. Source: local/STREAMING.md; src/producer.py; src/consumer.py.

Finite spikes remain, matching notebook evaluation; the notebook local adapter uses stricter bounds. Metrics reset on restart. Committed offsets determine replay.
